Coriander Powder HS Code and Wholesale Supply

Coriander powder is one of the most widely traded ground spices, bought in volume by masala blenders, snack makers and ready-meal producers. Knowing the coriander powder HS code helps importers and distributors plan their customs entries. The HS classification commonly used for coriander seeds, crushed or ground, is 09092200 in India, subject to confirmation with the destination country's customs authority. Tradenest Naturals supplies food grade coriander powder for wholesale, private label, and export applications. As a coriander powder exporter and coriander powder manufacturer in India, we offer consistent specifications, flexible packing and practical export assistance. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The seeds are dehydrated, cleaned, ground and sieved to achieve a uniform powder. Therefore, buyers receive a versatile ingredient for spice blends, sauces, snacks, ready meals, and seasoning systems. We can supply standard coriander powder, coriander powder 80 mesh, and coriander powder 100 mesh options based on the application and required texture.

Product Overview

Coriander powder delivers the warm, citrus-like character of coriander seeds in a convenient, ready-to-use form. It blends easily with dry ingredients and disperses well in many wet recipes. The powder supports efficient production because operators can dose it directly into formulations. Tradenest Naturals supplies this ingredient to food manufacturers, wholesalers, importers, restaurants, and private label brands. Before production, we review customer specifications for particle size, packaging, labeling and documentation. This approach helps buyers reduce delays and maintain product consistency across batches.
  • Natural ground coriander seed powder.
  • Food grade ingredient for commercial food processing.
  • Available in 80 mesh and 100 mesh grades.
  • Additive-free standard formulation, unless a buyer requests otherwise.
  • Bulk and private label supply from India.

Manufacturing and Processing Method

We begin with raw material inspection and supplier selection. Next, we clean the coriander seeds to remove visible foreign matter. We then use controlled grinding equipment to produce the required powder texture. After grinding, sieving helps achieve a more uniform mesh profile. Our process includes batch identification and production records. We also control moisture during handling and packing. As a result, the powder remains easier to store and use in industrial formulations. The exact process parameters may vary with the seed variety, order size, and customer specification. For large orders, our team can discuss customized processing and packaging requirements. We can also support private label and OEM projects. However, customized projects may require additional production planning.

Typical Technical Specifications

The following values represent typical commercial specifications. Buyers should confirm the final agreed specification before purchase. Product performance can vary slightly with crop season, origin, and processing conditions.
  • Product: Ground coriander seed powder
  • Mesh options: 80 / 100 mesh options
  • Moisture: ≤ 10%
  • Processing: Dehydrated, cleaned, ground and sieved
  • Color: Light greenish-brown to yellowish-brown
  • Flavor: Warm, fresh, mildly citrus-like, and aromatic
  • Formulation: Ground coriander seeds only, with no additives, for the standard product
A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. If your market requires specific analytical results, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Allergen statements and other destination-specific declarations can be discussed during quotation.

Applications

Coriander powder is a core ingredient in many savory food products. Its balanced aroma works well in both traditional and modern recipes. Moreover, it combines effectively with cumin, turmeric, chili, pepper, ginger, garlic, and other spices.
  • Seasoning blends and masala products.
  • Snack coatings, namkeen, and savory extruded snacks.
  • Ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat meals.
  • Soups, sauces, gravies, and curry bases.
  • Pickles, marinades, chutneys, and dips.
  • Meat, poultry, seafood, and plant-based protein seasonings.
  • Bakery and specialty savory formulations.
  • Foodservice recipes for restaurants, hotels, and cloud kitchens.
For finer dispersion, many manufacturers select coriander powder 100 mesh. For a slightly more textured spice profile, coriander powder 80 mesh may be suitable. Our team can recommend a grade after reviewing the recipe, processing equipment, and finished product requirements.

Quality, Traceability, and Export Support

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. We keep batch records for traceability and review incoming seed quality before processing. Then, we monitor cleaning, grinding, sieving, and packing steps. Each export shipment can include product and commercial documents required for the order. These may include a commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, and other documents where applicable. Please share your import checklist before confirming the order, so we can confirm which documents can be supplied. Our packaging uses food-grade, moisture-resistant materials. We label each shipment with essential traceability details, such as batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, and storage instructions. In addition, we can review destination labeling and private label artwork before production.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We offer retail, foodservice, wholesale, and export packaging formats. Standard options include 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg packs. Bulk bags and custom formats may also be available after technical review. When stored in a cool, dry, and clean place, typical shelf life is 12 months from manufacture. The product should remain sealed and protected from humidity, heat, direct sunlight, and strong odors. Once opened, buyers should reseal the pack and use clean, dry handling equipment. The final shelf life depends on the agreed specification, packaging barrier, and storage conditions.

MOQ, Pricing, Lead Time, and Samples

Ordering is kept simple for new buyers. Our MOQ is 5 Kg, which suits trial orders and first shipments. Samples are available on request. Larger private label or special export packaging projects are planned separately. Coriander powder price per kg depends on mesh size, raw material season, packaging, order quantity, and shipping terms. Therefore, we prepare quotations against clear specifications rather than using one fixed price. Bulk orders usually provide better cost efficiency and supply planning. Lead time depends on quantity, packaging and season, and we confirm it in writing with each quotation. Custom printed packaging may need extra time. To request a sample or quote, send the required mesh, quantity, destination country, packaging format, application, and target documents. Our team will then review availability and provide a suitable commercial proposal.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals

  • Direct contact with an FSSAI licensed manufacturer and exporter in Surat, India.
  • Flexible supply for wholesalers, importers, brands, and food processors.
  • 80 mesh and 100 mesh options for different production needs.
  • Food grade standard product with no additives.
  • Multiple pack sizes, export packaging, and private label support.
  • Batch traceability and a product specification sheet with every quotation.
  • Technical discussion for recipe, texture, and cost requirements.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What is the coriander powder HS code?

The commonly used Indian HS code is 09092200 for coriander seeds, crushed or ground. Customs classification can differ by country, so the importer should confirm the code locally.

What quality documents are available?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI licensed, and a product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Export documents are confirmed after we review the order.

What are the typical specifications?

Typical grades include 80 mesh and 100 mesh. Moisture is ≤ 10%, and shelf life is 12 months.

What packaging and shelf-life options are available?

We offer pouches, jars, HDPE containers, cartons, 25 kg packs, bulk bags, export packaging, and private label formats. Typical shelf life is 12 months when sealed and stored correctly.

How can I request a sample or quotation?

Share your required quantity, mesh size, destination, packaging, application, and documentation needs. We will review the request and advise the next steps.
